targetTasks.summary: Rerun the real BiliDili P10 project-index workflow parity test after accepted AlembicPlugin commit bdd0b62fb80082c032f299d3393eacb5bfd78eeb. Directly use the real BiliDili workspace only; do not create a sandbox copy and do not manually edit BiliDili source, DB, sessions, provider config, versions, or coverage ledger rows. Preserve configured providers: DeepSeek generation and local Qwen/Ollama embedding. Before running, verify pins and record them: AlembicPlugin bdd0b62fb80082c032f299d3393eacb5bfd78eeb, AlembicCore 99a7cf10d82056cd860eb0a1d9544662e3735b08, current Alembic/Alembic workspace pins, and BiliDili HEAD. Use alembic_bootstrap{rebuild:true} reset between runs as required by the state root. First prove R-2 root/dataRoot routing still holds: full host route uses dataRoot, full in-process route uses projectRoot, incremental route uses dataRoot. Then run the host route through bootstrap/dimension-completion/rescan/noPadding cleanup and capture raw snapshots before host, after bootstrap completion, after host rescan, and after noPadding cleanup. Success requires host coverage ledger non-empty and targetScopedOnly=true after bootstrap and after rescan; no aggregate/root module ids such as BiliDili, Sources, Packages/*, root, or module:root:* may be written or surfaced in coverageAdvisory when target cells exist; coverageLedgerSeed metadata must still be present; noPadding cleanup must leave active sessions and open rounds clear. Then run the in-process route with moduleScope=["BiliDili"] and verify it keeps nested ProjectMap target modules, writes a non-empty coverage ledger, and does not collapse to root-only or aggregate axes. Final parity predicate: normalized host vs in-process diff == empty, not a 0-vs-0 comparison. If blocked, return the first raw blocker with snapshots/log summaries and do not repair source in Test.
